summary: DFTHCSOS D5 stage-isolation kernel failed twice on kickmix API drift: the Kaggle image's kickmix is the competition's bundled kickmix.so (read-only), which does not expose the same public surface the reference circuit builder assumed. v1: km.CircuitBuilder missing; v2: km.Circuit.from_file present but OperationStatistics.num_ops missing. Root cause: the reference example (angle_k_reference_circuit.py) was written against a newer kickmix than the competition ships. Fix: stop building circuits locally and instead READ the shipped .kmb files with the competition's own kickmix, which is the exact build that wrote them. v3 succeeded.
root_cause: kickmix API version drift between the reference builder and the competition-shipped kickmix.so; the loop's 'build the circuits locally' step was not portable across kickmix versions.
